purpose: Teach: 緑化/痙攣/嘔吐/度数/積分/水蒸気/骨髄/流暢

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、都市部の緑化政策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered urban greening policy in your paper, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Slight upward lilt at the end — genuinely curious about her work. Patient pace, the comfort of a teacher who's read it carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、てんかんの痙攣機序を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the mechanisms of epileptic seizures.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. A faint hint of waiting to see if the teacher actually read it. Steady delivery, no embellishment. Watchful underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 抗がん剤による嘔吐対策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And antiemetic strategies for chemotherapy patients — that was your focus?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain. Gentle upward inflection, genuinely checking her understanding. The tone of someone who wants to get it right.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、視力度数の測定法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I researched measurement methods for refractive error in vision testing.
lines.style: Quiet correction without defensiveness. Slight emphasis on 'actually' — not confrontational, just clarifying. Patient with the teacher's misremembering.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 微積分の高校教育を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So calculus education at the high school level — that was your paper's subject?
lines.style: Engaged, leaning in slightly. Real interest in her answer. Mid-range pace, attentive listening. The energy of someone who wants to understand what she chose.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、温泉の水蒸気成分を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I focused on the water vapor components in hot spring sources.
lines.style: Calm, straightforward restatement. No frustration, just clarity. Matter-of-fact tone, the patience of explaining something simple. Level eye contact maintained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 骨髄移植の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The history of bone marrow transplantation, then — that was your research topic?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly uncertain again. Softer pace, the tone of someone genuinely trying to recall. Open-ended, waiting for the answer. Gentle acknowledgment of her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、語学学習者の流暢性測定を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I wrote about fluency measurement methods for language learners.
lines.style: Final answer, slightly weary but still engaged. Quiet precision. The tone of someone who has now corrected this pattern multiple times. Still respectful, but the weariness is underneath.
